$comment: genUI round 4 (MapPlaceholder, catalog/host.json media.map): the map tile's source rule, HAND-AUTHORED and replayed by packages/exponential-ui/src/map-tile.test.ts (web: imageSourceOf), MapTileTest.kt (Compose: SurfaceModel.imageSource), MapTileTests.swift (SwiftUI: SurfaceModel.imageSource); gpui applies the same rule in its Image stand-in (eui-gpui view/paint.rs image_stand_in). `src` = an Image src, `resolveUrl` = what the host's hook answers for it (null = a host without the hook, which keeps the src). `paints`: A `map:` src whose resolved URL is EMPTY or still a `map:` src is no tile. `nothing` = the Image paints nothing at all (no fetch, no fallback, no stand-in text); `load` = the ordinary media path (the resolved URL under the media policy).

cases.name: no host hook: a map tile paints nothing
a hook that leaves the map: src = nothing
a hook that resolves it to nothing (an offline host) = nothing
a hook that resolves it to a picture = load
